## src/planet/land/drape.ts

[Source](drape.ts)

Drape a polygon onto the heightfield.

Outer rings are filled. An inner ring becomes a hole only when it starts inside that outer ring.
Each triangle is clipped to the terrain the same way a road is, then dropped by `offset` metres.

## Module dependencies

- `three`
- `./roads/draped-road.js`
- `../../math/frame/vectors.js`
- `../../math/solid/mesh.js`
- `./terrain.js`

## src/planet/land/provider.ts

[Source](provider.ts)

GeoEuskadi road-area import.

Only surfaces in use at ground level are draped. Decks, underground ways and unknown
states are counted and skipped: an XY polygon cannot establish their height.

## src/planet/land/surface.ts

[Source](surface.ts)

OSM tags mapped onto a ground material.

Priority is natural, then landuse, then leisure. Water wins over a tag that would
otherwise be grass. `SURFACE_LAYERS` is the nesting order shared by the editor and batches.

## Module dependencies
